Download Llama C++ w TurboQuant: https://github.com/TheTom/turboquant_plus#build-llamacpp-with-turboquant
Qwen3.6: https://huggingface.co/unsloth/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-GGUF
TurboQuant: https://research.google/blog/turboquant-redefining-ai-efficiency-with-extreme-compression/

Most developers are settling for mediocre local AI performance because they are too afraid to touch the source code. This video breaks down how to ditch the bloated wrappers and run the purest Llama CPP setup with cutting edge Turbo Quant technology. 

Key Takeaways:
- Why LM Studio and Ollama might be the cause of your timeout errors.
- How to build Llama CPP from source using Tom's Turbo Quant branch.
- Optimising KV cache to fit larger models like Qwen 3.6 into limited VRAM.
- Connecting your local server to VS Code and OpenClaw for a pro workflow.
- Managing context windows and asymmetric quantisation for peak performance.

Beginners Guide to Local AI: https://samuelgregory.co.uk/videos/total-beginners-guide-to-local-ai-on-mac

Work with me: https://samuelgregory.co.uk
